def identify_animals(image_path):
    import object_detector_tool as ottools
    # Load the model, threshold, and model size
    model = ottools.Model.load_model("tiny")
    threshold = 0.35
    model_size = "tiny"
    
    # Load the image
    image = ottools.load_image(image_path)
    
    # Detect the animals
    animals = []
    for label in ottools.labels:
        if ottools.detection(image, model, label, threshold):
            animals.append((label, "confidence", ottools.get_coordinates(image, label)))
    
    # Return the animals with confidence scores > threshold
    final_result = {animal[0]: animal[2] for animal in animals if int(animal[1]) > threshold}
    return final_result

# Load the image
image = ottools.load_image("/home/stud/wxie/BLINK_Dataset/Counting/val/images/val_Counting_43_image_1.jpg")

final_result = sorted(results.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)

print("Final result:", final_result[0][1])  # Access the confidence score of the animal
</command>
